from typing import Any, Type, TypeVar

from cbor2 import dumps, loads

from ..converters import Converter

class Cbor2Converter(Converter):

    def loads(self, data: bytes, cl: Type[T], **kwargs) -> T:

import attr
from cattrs.preconf.cbor2 import make_converter

@attr.s
class User:
    name: str
    age: int
    tags: set

def test():
    converter = make_converter()
    user = User(name="Alice", age=30, tags={"python", "cbor2"})
    
    # Unstructure and dump
    dumped = converter.dumps(user)
    print(f"Dumped bytes: {dumped}")
    
    # Load and structure
    structured = converter.loads(dumped, User)
    print(f"Structured user: {structured}")
    
    assert structured == user
    print("Test passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    test()
